clips.title: The story
paras: The Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints are the technical schematics for an enormous mechanized woodcutter deployed by the Venture Company in Stonetalon Mountains. Designed under the supervision of the gnome engineer Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, the plans are heavily coveted by his disgruntled goblin rivals.

The Venture Company's relentless clear-cutting operation in Windshear Crag relies on massive mechanized lumber harvesters known as Super Reapers. To the utter dismay of traditional goblin engineers, the company placed a gnome named Gerenzo in charge of designing the Super Reaper 6000 model. These blueprints contain the schematics for the contraption, carried by Venture Co. operators working the machinery across the crag. When the goblin engineer Ziz Fizziks was ousted from the operation, he was quickly hired by Sputtervalve to steal the designs. However, deciphering Gerenzo's dense, eccentric gnomish technical notations proves to be almost as difficult as taking the blueprints by force.
